tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Find night train stations by name and/or ISO country code. Returns id, name, country, coordinates and the night train lines calling there.

tools.name: get_station
tools.description: All published facts for one station (lockers, toilets, showers, waiting room at night, step-free access...), each with source and observation date, plus facts not known yet.

tools.name: list_lines
tools.description: All European night train lines: id, name, operator, booking URL.

tools.name: get_line
tools.description: All published facts for one night train line (power sockets, bikes, pets, food on board, booking window...) with source and date, and its stations in order.

tools.name: facts_by_key
tools.description: One fact across all stations or lines, e.g. key "shower" for every station with a known shower. Use fact_keys for the list.

tools.name: punctuality
tools.description: How late night trains really arrive, per train, counted every night by us from Fintraffic and Trafikverket open data: on-time share (within 5 minutes at the last stop), median and 90th percentile delay, cancellations. Filter by line id, train number or country (FI, SE).

tools.name: fact_keys
tools.description: Every fact key with its type, allowed values and label.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_lines · Public sink: punctuality.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_lines · Public sink: punctuality

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
